name: 公司间占用和合同管理 (5W0)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item is only relevant for the Integration with SAP Cloud for Real Estate.

After you group Real Estate Objects (Buildings, Floors, Spaces, Land, Land Areas) in the Group Real Estate Object for Occupancy SAP Fiori app, manage and maintain them within the Manage Occupancy Groups SAP Fiori app.

Intercompany contract management functionality enables contracts for the lessee company and lessor companies automatically. It supports all relevant leasing processes like partner posting, valuation posting or rent adjustments.

You can use the Contract Management SAP Fiori app to create lease contracts. You can easily create new contracts, execute periodic postings, and valuation postings for existing contracts.

You can change the supplier or customer of an existing contract, as well as run reports of your existing contracts as part of your daily business.

You can create reminder rules for every contract, for example, to check the contract conditions, the contract term, or the renewal options, helping you to save time and effort and free up capacity for more strategic tasks.

Key Process Flow

  • Open Group Real Estate Object for Occupancy (F5592) app
  • Search for building or land to be occupied by an affiliated company by company code and object type
  • Create object group with intercompany object category
  • Check occupancy of real estate objects

Business Benefits

  • Use single repository for all real estate assets in the entire portfolio independent of back-end system
  • Collect costs by real estate location, supporting financial reporting and location analysis
  • View vacancy/occupancy reporting for each location based on space type
  • Get simplified contract management for leasing between affiliated companies
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目仅与与 SAP Cloud for Real Estate 集成相关。

在分组要占用的不动产对象 SAP Fiori 应用中对不动产对象（建筑物、楼层、空间、土地、土地范围）进行分组后，在管理占用组 SAP Fiori 应用中管理和维护它们。

内部公司间合同管理功能自动为承租人和出租人公司启用合同。它支持所有相关租赁流程，例如合作伙伴过账、评估过账或租金调整。

您可以使用合同管理 SAP Fiori 应用创建租赁合同。您可以轻松创建新合同、执行定期过账以及现有合同的评估过账。

您可以更改现有合同的供应商或客户，并在日常业务中运行现有合同的报告。

您可以为每个合同创建提醒规则，例如，检查合同条件、合同条款或续订选项，帮助您节省时间和工作量，并释放更多战略任务的能力。

关键流程流

  • 打开“分组要占用的不动产对象 (F5592)”应用
  • 按公司代码和对象类型搜索联营公司要占用的建筑物或土地。
  • 创建具有公司间对象类别的对象组
  • 检查不动产对象的占用

业务优势

  • 独立于后端系统，为整个投资组合中的所有不动产资产使用单一资源库
  • 按不动产位置收集成本，支持财务报告和位置分析
  • 根据空间类型查看每个位置的空缺/占用报告
  • 简化联营公司之间租赁的合同管理
